items.atribucion: «Mars Report: Update on NASA’s Perseverance Rover SuperCam Instrument» — NASA · images.nasa.gov
items.resumen: Since landing on the Red Planet, NASA's Mars 2020 Perseverance rover has been hard at work analyzing rocks and soil on the floor of Jezero Crater with the SuperCam instrument.
